title: Summary for Hurricane Rachel (EP3/EP182026)
summary: ...RACHEL WEAKENS SLIGHTLY AS IT CONTINUES WESTWARD... As of 2:00 AM MST Sat Oct 03 the center of Rachel was located near 19.4, -111.8 with movement W at 5 mph. The minimum central pressure was 969 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 90 mph.
author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
